newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slip on low volume.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slip on low volume.

text.p: Slovenian shares closed 1.52 percent down in low volume on Monday, continuing a downward correction begun at the end of last week, and traders forecast prices would drift in the absence of fresh impulses.

"Domestic investors do not have enough money to put into all the shares that would be worth buying and foreigners will stay away until there is fresh news. That could take at least three weeks," said Andrej Potocnik, a trader at brokerage BPH.
In February the central bank restricted international investors' access to the market by ordering them to open custody accounts.
* The SBI index fell 20.2 points to 1,312.94.
* Overall 12 shares fell, four rose and 10 were untraded.
* Market's turnover tumbled to 38.5 million tolars from 66.7 million. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
